heading: Tuesday, March 25, 2025
topLine: 3 model releases: Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek-V3-0324 and OpenAI GPT-4o image generation.

items.headline: Google introduces Gemini 2.5 Pro, a thinking model
items.summary: Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental was the first Gemini 2.5 model, built to reason before responding. Google reported it debuted at #1 on LMArena and scored 18.8% on Humanity's Last Exam without tools; it shipped with a 1M-token context window.

image.alt: Gemini 2.5 Pro reasoning, science and math scores compared with other models

items.headline: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-V3-0324 update
items.summary: DeepSeek-V3-0324 is an updated DeepSeek-V3 checkpoint that the company says improves reasoning, front-end development and tool use. Weights are on Hugging Face under the MIT License, and API usage is unchanged.

items.headline: OpenAI adds native image generation to GPT-4o
items.summary: OpenAI built image generation directly into GPT-4o as an autoregressive model, replacing DALL-E as ChatGPT's default image generator. OpenAI highlighted improved text rendering, prompt following and multi-turn editing; images carry C2PA metadata. API access followed later as gpt-image-1.
